category_aggregation: Pooled per-category IoU sums TP/FP/FN over all positive image/category pairs for that category; absent-category images are excluded. Also report macro mean per-positive-image/category IoU, matching the V1 Phase 3 aggregation.
ground_truth: COCO val2014 instance masks; non-crowd instances unioned by category; crowd pixels excluded; fractional 16x16 occupancy and aligned binary 224 targets
v1_embedding_aggregation: mean raw text embedding across seven templates before V1 MLP projection and L2 normalization
v1_visual_features: final-layer normalized DINO patch features from the cached V1-compatible extraction
v2_prompt_source: single training prompt: a photo of a <category>
v2_visual_features: OpenVLA penultimate DINO patch features from the standard 224x224 path
